law_name: Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU PDP)
enforcement_authority: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
deceased_data: Not explicitly regulated: law focuses on living data subjects; no provision on deceased persons or heirs
research_exemption: Certain data subject rights exempted for scientific research purposes (art. 15(1)(e)); safeguards not detailed
genetic_data: Specific (sensitive) personal data incl. genetic, biometric and health data (art. 4(2)); stricter safeguards
notes: Implementing GR 33/2026 effective 2027-01-16; DPA not yet formed (Mar 2026)
pending_change: Implementing regulation PP 33/2026 takes effect (promulgated 16 Jul 2026)
